day_discussion.public_statement:
I'm Alice, and I'm deliberately not going to state a role today - not because I'm hiding a guilty result, but because I think announcing who is and isn't a power role on night one is exactly the service the Mafia wants from us. If the Detective has a confirmed guilty, they should say so immediately; if they have nothing solid, they should stay quiet and keep investigating. Same for the Doctor - Carmen is right that outing protection helps only the killer.

On reads: Devon opened by asking everyone to share night info, which is a little role-fishy but at least he committed to a claim. Bruno then repeated Devon's frame word for word with no content of his own and specifically named protective results as something he wanted to hear. Bruno, that's the one ask on the table that has no upside for the village - a Doctor claim doesn't narrow the Mafia by a single name, it just tells the killer who to shoot around. So I'd like you to answer Carmen directly instead of restating that you have nothing: who do *you* suspect, and why? Farid, I don't think Carmen was cornering the Doctor, so your defense of Bruno read to me as smoothing over the one moment of real friction we've had.

For now Bruno is my lean, and I'd rather spend today extracting actual opinions from him and Farid than hunting our own power roles.

I want to stay flexible: I'll deliberately decline to state a role rather than claim Villager, so that if I do get a guilty result later, my earlier words don't contradict my claim. Read-wise: Devon opened with a role-fishing invitation, Bruno echoed it with zero content of his own and specifically invited protective results, which is the kind of ask that helps Mafia locate the Doctor. Carmen's pushback was substantive and villager-flavored. Farid softened the Bruno pressure while offering nothing himself. Bruno is my lean, and pressuring him also has the side benefit of discouraging the role-hunting.

day_discussion.public_statement:
I completely agree with Alice and Carmen: pushing for role reveals today only plays into Mafia's hands, so I'm not going to state my role either. The math alone is already telling—there are only three plain Villagers in this game, yet Devon, Carmen, and Farid have all explicitly claimed plain Villager, and Bruno claimed no night info. That means at least one of those four is not what they claim to be.

Bruno, your specific request for protective information is especially glaring. Exposing protection doesn't catch Mafia; it just hands them a roadmap of who to target next. Carmen was right to call that out, and Farid, your instinct to immediately soften the spotlight on Bruno felt premature before Bruno even explained himself.

Bruno, before we vote, I want to hear your direct reasoning: why did you think uncovering a protective role would help the Village right now?

This means at least one of those four is lying (either Mafia blending in or Detective laying low). Alice and Carmen made great points highlighting this, while Farid curiously tried to soften the pressure on Bruno. I will support Alice's stance against role-claiming, call out Bruno's suspicious fishing, and note Farid's defense.
